description: This file is a source implementation for font loading and rendering in a graphics application using FreeType and OpenGL, including functions for initializing FreeType, loading fonts, measuring, and rendering text.

methods.name: void lu5_init_freetype(lu5_State * l5)
methods.description: Initializes the FreeType library within the provided lu5_State.

methods.name: int lu5_load_font(lu5_State * l5,lu5_font ** fontId,const char * fontPath)
methods.description: Loads a font from file or memory, creates textures for characters, and sets font size.

methods.name: lu5_font * lu5_load_and_add_font(lu5_State * l5,const char * font_path)
methods.description: Loads a font from a path, adds it to the font list, and returns the font object.

methods.name: void lu5_measure_text(const char * text,int * width,int * height,int * max_bearing_y,lu5_font * font)
methods.description: Calculates width, height, and maximum bearing Y for a given text with a font.

methods.name: void lu5_render_text(const char * text,float x,float y,float fontSize,int textAlign,lu5_font * font,lu5_color color)
methods.description: Renders the specified text with given position, size, alignment, font, and color.

methods.name: void lu5_load_default_font(lu5_State * l5)
methods.description: Loads the default font for the application.

methods.name: void lu5_close_font(lu5_font * font)
methods.description: Closes and releases resources for a specific font.

methods.name: void lu5_close_fonts(lu5_State * l5)
methods.description: Closes all fonts associated with the lu5_State, including cleanup.
